title: DORA Major-Incident Classifier (2024/1772 Art. 8(1) Gateway)
description: Classifies an ICT-related incident as major or not-major under Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1772 Art. 8(1): critical services (Art. 6) AND either the Art. 9(5)(b) successful-malicious-access condition or two or more of the other Art. 9(1)-(6) materiality thresholds, with their absolute and relative limbs (clients count AND share, downtime AND duration, economic impact), Art. 8(2) recurring-incident aggregation, and DORA Art. 18(1)(a)-(f) criteria labels in statutory order. Consumes the 2025/301 clock result from art-467 (art-467 feeds art-09) and marks it binding only on a major determination; accepts a caller-declared clock result of the same shape standalone; an origin mismatch yields not_evaluable stages, never silent precedence. Deterministic, no wall clock, no network.

critical_services_affected.description: Art. 6 / Art. 8(1) gateway — the mandatory gate; absence yields not_evaluable

clients_affected_pct.description: Art. 9(1)(a): percentage of all clients using the affected service (threshold: higher than 10%)

clients_affected_count.description: Art. 9(1)(b): number of affected clients (threshold: higher than 100,000)

financial_counterparts_affected_pct.description: Art. 9(1)(c): percentage of financial counterparts on the affected service (threshold: higher than 30%)

transactions_affected_number_pct.description: Art. 9(1)(d): percentage of daily average transaction count (threshold: higher than 10%)

transactions_affected_value_pct.description: Art. 9(1)(e): percentage of daily average transaction value (threshold: higher than 10%)

art_1_3_relevant_parties_affected.description: Art. 9(1)(f): Art. 1(3)-relevant clients or financial counterparts affected

reputational_impact.description: Art. 9(2): reputational impact per Art. 2(a)-(d), caller-assessed

duration_hours.description: Art. 9(3)(a): incident duration in hours (threshold: longer than 24)

critical_function_downtime_minutes.description: Art. 9(3)(b): service downtime in minutes on critical/important functions (threshold: longer than 120)

member_states_affected_count.description: Art. 9(4): Member States impacted (threshold: two or more)

data_loss_adverse_impact.description: Art. 9(5)(a): data loss with adverse impact on business objectives or regulatory compliance — two-other branch only, never standalone

malicious_access_successful.description: Art. 9(5)(b): successful, malicious, unauthorised access — the single-condition branch inside the gateway

economic_impact_eur.description: Art. 9(6): costs and losses in EUR (threshold: exceeding 100,000)

recurring_incident_group_ref.description: Art. 8(2) recurring-incident group reference; when declared, the threshold inputs carry the COLLECTIVE assessment

recurring_occurrences_within_6_months.description: Art. 8(2)(a): occurrences within 6 months (threshold: at least twice)

recurring_same_root_cause.description: Art. 8(2)(b): same apparent root cause per DORA Art. 20 first subparagraph (b)

recurring_exemption_applies.description: Art. 8(2) exemption: microenterprise or Art. 16(1) entity — aggregation not applied

awareness_at.description: ISO-8601 with explicit offset; cross-checked against the consumed clock result origin

classification_at.description: ISO-8601 with explicit offset; cross-checked against the consumed clock result origin

reporting_clock.description: The consumed art-467 2025/301 clock result (or a caller-declared one of the same shape, standalone); origin mismatch marks stages not_evaluable

output_example.table_source: DORA (EU) 2022/2554 Art. 18(1) (criteria, statutory order (a)-(f)) + Arts. 19-20 (reporting obligations); Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1772 Art. 8(1) (critical-services gateway AND (9(5)(b) malicious access OR two or more other Art. 9 thresholds)) + Art. 9(1)-(6) (materiality thresholds with their absolute and relative limbs) + Art. 8(2) (recurring-incident aggregation); clock result consumed from art-467 (2025/301 Art. 5).
output_example.note: DORA 2024/1772 Art. 8(1) classification over caller-declared threshold limbs. The 2025/301 reporting clock is NOT computed here: under the REVERSED D split this kernel consumes the art-467 clock result through the declared edge (art-467 feeds -> art-09) and marks it binding only on a major determination; a mismatch between declared timestamps and consumed origins yields not_evaluable stages, never silent precedence. A caller-declared clock result of the same shape keeps this kernel usable standalone. This kernel classifies only; it does not itself transmit, file, or submit any regulatory notification, and it is not legal advice.
